name: SchemaSeed
description: Generate deterministic synthetic test data from the current DBX table schema for development, integration testing and functional validation, with preview and CSV / JSON / INSERT SQL export.
releaseNotes: First DBX Store release: generate deterministic synthetic test data from the current DBX table schema with preview and CSV / JSON / INSERT SQL export. This version saves exports through the DBX Host native save dialog and reports saved / cancelled / failed separately.
